description: Turns Install as app on or off for one site, as the project settings' Install as app section does, and optionally chooses how the installed site opens. Only owners and admins can. The site then updates itself and the update goes live once it passes its checks: tell the person that (whatHappensNext), never that it is already live. Answers status saved, unchanged, forbidden or invalid.

on.description: True lets visitors install the site; false stops it.

opens.description: How the installed site opens, as get_install_as_app lists the ways (standalone or minimal-ui). Only with on true; left out keeps the current way, or standalone when turning it on.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: set_install_as_app
title: Turn Install as app on or off
